'''Milen Rort''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Rort often shared his knowledge with his fellow agents as a combat instructor.<ref name="TOR" />
